name: Steam distillation
about: Steam carries the oil out of the plant. Fast and dependable.

name: Cold pressing
about: The peel is pressed without heat. Citrus only; the freshest result.

name: Solvent extraction
about: A solvent draws out a waxy concrete, which is washed into an absolute. Slower and pricier, but richer.

name: CO₂ extraction
about: Supercritical carbon dioxide gently extracts a very true-to-nature oil. Slow and costly.

name: Enfleurage
about: Flowers laid on fat for days, replaced again and again. Very slow, tiny yield, the finest result. Almost never done today.

name: Curing, then extraction
about: Green vanilla pods are blanched, sweated, sun-dried and conditioned for months before they're extracted.
